incidents.name: SVT pool flawed price calculation
incidents.notes: The SVT pool derives the redemption price from its own token balance instead of a tracked accounting figure, so a direct SVT transfer into the pool inflated the redemption rate and let the attacker take out its USDT.

sources.ref: onchain review: SVT pool 0x2120F8F305347b6aA5E5dBB347230a8234EB3379 created 2023-08-25T01:38:02Z by 0xc1deb2d5a76dbe0cb1ff0cdaf34b86d4e4c6bd25, unrelated to attack sender 0x4b44b52ef15f7aab9a0a6cfdfa8d2c5eeeb6d8c3; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 517,684.52 USDT left the pool, of which 397,782.46 USDT went to the attack contract 0x1c651b04bdd1c1718eeeafede0a3c13e87024fa2 (the remainder repaid the flash loan).
